description: This file is a script for static code analysis that enforces constraints on the usage of pairing-store identifiers within other source files. It loads project configuration, defines rules to detect improper references to pairing-store identifiers, and reports violations to maintain code security and correctness.

methods.name: getDeclarationNameText
methods.description: Extracts the name text from a variable or binding declaration.

methods.name: containsPairingStoreSource
methods.description: Checks if a node contains references to pairing-store identifiers or related call expressions.

methods.name: getCallName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a call expression node.

methods.name: isSuspiciousNormalizeWithStoreCall
methods.description: Detects calls to normalizeAllowFromWithStore with pairing-store entries, which are considered suspicious.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Analyzes the source code to identify violations of pairing-store reference rules.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to execute the code analysis and output violations.
